text: PHASE 1 ONLY: in Laubrary, Zounds has its old styled look back (warm gradient tabs, glowing title, bordered buttons, gold volume slider), because the original style file now ships inside Laubrary instead of being replaced by an empty one. HH2Lab has deliberately NOT been touched yet. Please look at the comparison picture and confirm it looks right before I copy it over.
details:
What you'll see: open Laubrary > Zounds. The Browser, Routing and Settings tabs and the Klip and Zequence editors all use the old look again. Screenshots are attached: one side-by-side (old project, Laubrary before, Laubrary after) and the individual windows.

Icons: no icon files were added at all. The old style file never pointed at icons; Zounds already gets every icon it shows from a folder that's already in Laubrary. So the minimal set you asked for turned out to be zero.

Other Laubrary tools keep their current look. The review caught that the Zounds style would have leaked into the shared asset browser's filter buttons, and that's fixed.

Difference you'll notice: the old style's larger font clips the 'Volume 57-67' label in the Zound rows (the 'Chance' label was already clipped before). Tell me if you want that tightened.

Not yet verified by eye: the Zounds window after closing and reopening it. The Unity editor was in the background and Windows wouldn't let it come forward, so the reopened window never appeared on screen to photograph. A probe confirmed it reopened with the right style.

Not applicable: the task asked to check pattern fills and multi-stop gradients. The old style file switches off all of its patterns and has no gradient with more than two colours, so neither affects the Zounds look.

Next step (phase 2, only after you say so): copy the same style file and start-up fix into HH2Lab and check it there the same way.
technicalDetails:
Commit e5811d88 on dev (only T-0343 paths; the many other uncommitted changes in the tree were left alone).
Files:
- D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\Zounds\ZUI Assets\ZOUNDS ZUI Style Sheet.asset: the old D:\UNITY\Zounds sheet, same GUID e20964114e799464eb4e977adca28957. Byte-identical except m_EditorClassIdentifier (now the ZuiRuntime one) and consumerName: Zounds, so ZUI.AutoDiscoverConsumerSheets registers it even when delayCall is stalled.
- D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\Zounds\ZoundsZUIBootstrap.cs: lookup order is GUID, then beside the script, then legacy Assets/Zounds or Assets/ZoundsData, then CreateDefaultSheet (project-local only, never into the package). Retries Register up to 10 times if the GUID is known but not yet loadable. REMOVED ZUI.SetDefaultActiveSheet: with a styled sheet it restyled unscoped legacy ZUI.* draws, e.g. D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\AssetKit\LauAssetBrowser.cs:220-228 (a PopupWindowContent). Zounds itself doesn't need it: ZoundsWindow scopes via ConsumerSheetName, BaseZoundEditorWindow via UseSheet("Zounds"), and none of Zounds' popups or custom inspectors call ZUI.*.
- Deleted the empty placeholder D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Zounds (git rm).
- D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\CHANGELOG.md: new T-0343 entry.
Icons: the old sheet has iconAliases: []. All 15 icon names Zounds requests resolve through ZUI.FindIcon(x) ?? Resources.Load("ZoundsWindowIcons/x") against the existing package Resources folder, so none were copied. The old project's K KLIP / Z ZEQ / cool icon / COPYYY / TEST are unused.
Render paths: the probe walked every ZUIColor in the sheet. There are 28 gradients, all with 2 stops or fewer, and all 28 GetOrBuildTexture calls succeed. There are 45 ZUIPatternDefs, all with enabled=0. Glow and outline are visible on the title and tabs.
Environment: the unfocused editor never drains EditorApplication.delayCall, and new EditorWindows don't get native windows until it does; unity-mcp editor_focus didn't help. Captures use PrintWindow via D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\.agenthq\workspace\T-0343\capture-window.ps1 (matched by PID and title, DPI-aware).
State left behind: the Zounds window was closed and reopened at the same rect (319,164 1082x693) on the Browser tab. It will appear when the editor next gets focus. EditorPrefs ZUIStyleEditor_LastSheet still points at the deleted placeholder path, which is harmless (loads null).
Phase 2 recipe: memory zounds-look-sheet-restore-t0343.md. HH2Lab's vendored bootstrap is at Assets/Zounds/Editor/Zounds/. Its placeholder (GUID 46833420...) must be replaced by the sheet, otherwise the local-path fallback keeps loading it.
Subagents: Explore (inherited Opus 5), read-only inventory. general-purpose reviewer (Sonnet 5): approve with fixes, both fixes applied.

proof.text: Packaged sheet loaded live: 8 buttons, 5 boxes, 5 text styles, 6 sliders, 10 colours, registered as the Zounds sheet from the package path
Bootstrap resolves the packaged sheet by GUID; no placeholder is recreated after a domain reload; console clean
Old look confirmed by eye in live captures: Zounds Browser/Routing/Settings tabs + Klip and Zequence editors
All 28 gradients build textures (0 failures); patterns all disabled and no >2-stop gradients in the sheet, so those paths are unused
No leak into other tools: after the bootstrap runs, the ambient ZUI sheet stays empty
Zero icons needed: all 15 requested icon names resolve from the existing package Resources folder (independently re-verified by the reviewer)
Independent review done; both should-fix findings fixed
Reopened Zounds window seen by eye (editor could not be brought to the foreground)
HH2Lab (phase 2) untouched, waiting on owner confirmation
